method: Class-specific nominal battery capacity and physical pack mass; both driving modes carry the same pack.
capacity boundary: Nominal/gross capacity. Existing 0.8 depth of discharge retained; no manufacturer usable-capacity claim.
physical property boundary: Effective NMC-622 PHEV cell density = nominal capacity / (pack mass * 0.7). The 0.7 cell fraction and NMC-622 chemistry are retained modelling proxies, not manufacturer cell measurements.
uncertainty boundary: Existing triangular relative bounds retained: pack mass +/-20%, effective cell density +/-5%; these are modelling assumptions, not manufacturer tolerances.
coverage boundary: Both petrol and diesel PHEVs use the same size-specific pack proxies. Micro remains unavailable and inherits the Mini inputs.
source access boundary: BMW technical tables were retrieved through the indexed original manufacturer PDFs; direct PDF downloads returned 404 on 2026-10-14. URLs and section/page locators are retained.

Mini.boundary: Prius pack is a cross-size proxy; no native 2020 Mini PHEV reference.

Small.boundary: Prius pack is a cross-size proxy; no native 2020 Small PHEV reference.

Lower medium.boundary: Golf nominal capacity; mass inferred using BMW 330e pack density, not a measured Golf mass.

Medium.boundary: BMW G20 SP41, manual section 5, printed page 81; mass excludes retaining brackets.

Large.boundary: BMW 530e nominal capacity; BMW 330e pack mass is an explicit cross-model proxy excluding retaining brackets.

Medium SUV.boundary: RAV4 late-2020 nominal capacity; mass inferred using BMW 330e pack density, not a measured RAV4 mass.

Large SUV.boundary: BMW G05 SP44, manual section 5.2, printed page 31; 500 lb converted to kg and rounded to 0.1 kg, including retaining bracket.

Van.boundary: Ford Tourneo Custom series-hybrid capacity; mass inferred using BMW 330e pack density; battery-only proxy, not a replica of its drivetrain.
